verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a browser-automation platform, but nothing in the evidence documents running Notte on your own infrastructure. The docs describe cloud browser sessions and serverless functions. The GitHub repo snippets cover agent features, not self-host deployment. 'Bring your own keys' is an adjacent capability, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
